detailReview.method: The original 150 details were reviewed across native-resolution sheets and high-risk original 1600x1080 details. After the shared CALL annotation fix changed six selected artifacts, the CALL details and Program sheets at 75, 100, and 150 percent were re-reviewed; the other 168 artifacts were byte-identical.

sheetReview.method: All family contact sheets were inspected for framing and catalog consistency. The three regenerated Program sheets were rechecked after the CALL fix; fine text was judged from original details.

limitations: This is a hash-bound review of local RungProof renderer artifacts, not an installed TIA Portal comparison.
The generated PNGs and source manifest remain ignored ephemeral-local files; this checked-in verdict does not make the pixels portable.
The reviewed set covers selected offline rendering with symbolic and absolute operands, tag information shown on operands, and 75, 100, and 150 percent zoom.
Installed-TIA edit and online captures, live PLC execution, project interchange, downloading, forcing, and commissioning remain unproved.
